_what_this_is: Head refit on cached frozen-backbone features, vs the head already in the checkpoint. Both scored on the same split with the evaluator's own metrics.
_question: Is the 596M backbone update the lever, or would 2.37M head parameters on frozen features have done the same job?
_limits: seed checkpoint only: says nothing yet about what 600 LoRA steps buy
single fit, no seed dispersion: a small gap is not evidence

feature_cache_fidelity.statement: The cached features reproduce the model's own logits BIT-IDENTICALLY (model._score(encode_candidates(batch)) vs model(batch)['logits'], both splits). The 16-second refit therefore measured the model, not the cache.

cost_comparison.note: Even paying the cache from scratch, the cheap route is ~16x cheaper than ONE replicate, and the cache is reusable across every future head experiment.
